name: agentic-sdlc
description: Skills for a delivery process run with coding agents (evidence-tagged claims, plans with gates, reviewable slices, test-first, reviews in Conventional Comments) plus a PreToolUse hook that refuses tool attribution, bulk staging, force-pushes to protected branches and key-shaped literals. In agent mode, the default, nothing asks: commits, pushes and posts run and are recorded, and a credential read or print, a change to the guard's configuration and a production database write are refused. Confirm mode asks before every commit, push and post. The hook runs in Claude Code and in Codex.
